scenario: AITA - For not extending a specific invitation to two nieces for an annual family event that everyone is invited to? | Every year, on the last day of March, we gather as a family to celebrate my father-in-law’s life at a specific restaurant. Sometimes people bring friends and it is never a big deal and we all celebrate a great man. This year, we had 3 of the 4 of my mother-in-law’s kids and their families come and had a wonderful time.
